description_ru: Школьники едут в зоопарк, где обезьяна крадёт сумку одной из девочек.
text:
Mr. Hall: Good morning, children. Today is a special day. We go to the zoo!
Kate: Hooray! Mr. Hall, can we see the penguins?
Mr. Hall: Yes, Kate, we see the penguins, the lions and the big elephants. But first, some rules. Stay with your partner, and listen to me at all times.
Leo: Mr. Hall, can I bring my sandwich on the bus?
Mr. Hall: You can eat on the bus, Leo, but please keep your hands clean. Now, everybody, get on the bus.
Kate: Leo, you are my partner today. Don't lose me, please!

Kate: Look, Leo! The bus is moving. I see a horse and two cows in a field.
Leo: I see them too. How long is the ride to the zoo?
Kate: Mr. Hall says it takes forty minutes. Do you want to play a game?
Leo: Yes! I see something blue. Can you guess?
Kate: Is it the sky?
Leo: No, it is your bag! Now you give me a game.

Mr. Hall: We are here, children. Look at the big gate. Line up in pairs, please.
Leo: Wow, there are so many people! Where do we go first?
Mr. Hall: First, we go to the monkeys. They are very funny today. Follow me, and don't run.
Kate: Look, one monkey eats a banana. And that little one is hanging from a tree by its tail!
Leo: He looks at me. Hello, monkey! Do you want my sandwich?
Mr. Hall: Please don't feed the animals, Leo. They have their own food.

Mr. Hall: Is everybody here? Let me count. Kate, Leo, Sara, Tim, Ben, Anna. Good, all twenty children are here.
Kate: Mr. Hall, I have a question. Can we have lunch at the zoo?
Mr. Hall: Yes, at twelve o'clock, near the big lake. You can sit on the grass.
Leo: I am already hungry. It is only nine o'clock.
Mr. Hall: Leo, you ate a sandwich on the bus! Please wait.

Leo: Kate, look at the sign. It says, lions, this way. Can we visit them after the penguins?
Kate: Yes, I want to see the baby lion. My brother says there is a new one.
Leo: A baby lion! I hope it is awake.
Kate: Lions sleep twenty hours a day. Maybe we see only a big yellow ball of fur.

Kate: Mr. Hall, it is time for the penguins. Please, can we go now?
Mr. Hall: Yes, they are in the next building. It is cold inside, so wear your jackets.
Leo: Oh, they are so small, and they walk like funny little men. Look, one is falling into the water!
Kate: They swim so fast! The black and white colours are beautiful. I want to take a photo.
Leo: Kate, where is your camera? In your bag?
Kate: Oh no. My bag! I leave it on the bench near the monkeys.

Leo: Don't panic, Kate. We go back and look for it. Mr. Hall, we have a problem.
Mr. Hall: What is the problem, children?
Kate: I lose my bag. It has my camera and my lunch. I leave it near the monkeys.
Mr. Hall: Okay. Stay calm. We walk back to the monkeys together. The other children wait here with Miss Ray.
Leo: I run in front and look!
Mr. Hall: No running, Leo. We stay together.

Kate: Look, there is the bench. But my bag is not here! It is gone.
Leo: Wait. Do you hear that noise? Someone is laughing near the trees.
Mr. Hall: Yes, I hear it. Let's go and see.
Kate: Oh my goodness! A monkey has my bag. He is sitting in the tree, and he is eating my sandwich!
Leo: Ha ha ha! He likes your lunch, Kate. Look at his face.
Mr. Hall: I call the zookeeper. Don't move, children.

Zookeeper: Good afternoon. I hear you have a problem. Oh, this is Charlie again. He loves to steal bags.
Kate: Can you get my bag back? My camera is inside.
Zookeeper: Of course. Charlie, come here. Look, I have a banana. Give me the bag and you get the banana.
Leo: He is giving it back! He is a clever monkey.
Kate: Thank you, sir. The camera is safe, and I still have the photos of the penguins.

Mr. Hall: Now children, we sit by the lake and have lunch. Sara and Tim, please give everybody some water.
Leo: Where is my sandwich? Oh no, I have no sandwich! The monkey is not the only hungry one today.
Kate: Don't worry, Leo. The monkey only eats half of mine. I share the rest with you.
Leo: Thank you, Kate. You are the best partner in the world.
Mr. Hall: After lunch it is time to go home. Everybody get on the bus. Kate, tell the class about your day.
Kate: I am never leaving my bag again. But it is the best day ever!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Спинка языка касается мягкого нёба, звук идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.
Долгий «и», растяните губы в улыбке; он длиннее русского «и».
Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не заменяйте на «ф» и не произносите как русское «в».
Начните с «а» и плавно перейдите к «и»; звук скользящий, а не два отдельных.

questions.question: What does Kate lose?
questions.answer: Her bag with her camera and lunch.

questions.question: How does the zookeeper get the bag back?
questions.answer: He gives the monkey a banana.
